set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 9. Introduce namespaced object and representation identities, typed payload roles, a narrow descriptor envelope, distinct archive/representation versions, the pure factual LnaArchiveManifestAdapter for the current LNA 2 model, and the admitted canonical writer. Acceptance: LNA and canonical fixtures read; canonical writes emit only the admitted normalized form; unknown representations remain structurally validatable; adaptation is pure and fixture-tested; logical payload identity is stable across layouts; raw numeric bits are preserved unless the profile declares normalization; injected failure after every proper canonical-write prefix never publishes; external conformance and the frozen numerical corpus remain green.
set.title: RRA 9: normalize the NeuroArchive manifest and LNA adaptation
